messages:
Priya (CSM): FYI Helios renewal hits 2025-06-01. Procurement just asked to switch billing to 6-month cycles and requested a 10% one-time concession on the upcoming period. They attached a PO and want an amendment with their PO number.

Jamal (AE): Understood. Any legal asks in the PO?

Priya (CSM): Yes, they altered the indemnity & liability sections. Looping Legal + Finance. PO link: https://files.example/helios/PO_4521.pdf

Katherine (Finance): 10% is high. We can offer 5% on 6-mo billing, or 7% if they agree to a 2x committed spend in the first year and a 12-mo auto-renew. Need RevOps to sign-off for recognition flow.

Priya (CSM): I'll float the commitment option.

LegalBot: Automated review: client removed our liability cap and broadened indemnity. Not acceptable as-is. Recommend: retain cap; offer narrowed indemnity limited to IP/data breach claims. Will prepare redline.

procurement-rep (Helios): We really need 6-mo billing for cashflow reasons. On indemnity: we can accept IP/data-limited indemnity, but request "data handling" defined to include subprocessors. Is that workable?

LegalBot: Acceptable with precise definition. We'll draft a short appendix defining "data handling" and subprocessors scope. Can Helios approve by EOD Thursday?

OnboardOps: Heads-up 94 changing to biannual billing affects when onboarding credits vest. If they want credits front-loaded, revenue recognition will differ. Need decision ASAP to prep SOW.

Priya (CSM): @OnboardOps prepare two SOW credit schedules (front-loaded and pro-rata) so we can present options.

Jamal (AE): Also want to lock an add-on seat floor to avoid underpricing if they scale quickly. Suggested floor: 80% of list.

Katherine (Finance): Agree to floor at 80%. I'll add that to the amendment pricing table.

Priya (CSM): Sending counterproposal: 6-mo billing, 7% concession on first term if 2x usage commitment + 12-mo auto-renew; limited indemnity for IP/data with subprocessors appendix; add-on floor 80%; onboarding credits front-loaded. Attaching redline now.

priya_redline_v1.pdf (attachment): [redline snapshot]

procurement-rep (Helios): Reviewing. Please include our PO reference (PO-4521) in the amendment header and add a clause that the billing cadence change is effective 2025-06-01.

Priya (CSM): Will add PO-4521 and effective date. Sending updated redline.

esig-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0xA2B3) 94 recipients: Helios procurement, Priya, Legal. Status: awaiting client signature.

procurement-rep (Helios): Signed on our side this morning, waiting for Redwood countersign.

LegalBot: Final review complete. Minor formatting tweaks; substance approved. Ready for countersign.

Priya (CSM): Countersigned and uploaded to DocuSign. :white_check_mark:

esig-bot: Envelope env_0xA2B3 completed 94 all signatures obtained. Signed PDF: https://docusign.example/env_0xA2B3/signed.pdf

Priya (CSM): Next steps: Finance to schedule biannual invoices starting 2025-06-01 with concession applied to first invoice; OnboardOps to confirm kickoff date and which credit schedule Helios chose; Jamal to update SFDC and mark renewal closed. I'll follow-up with an internal task list.

Katherine (Finance): I'll create invoice schedule and confirm revenue recognition path.

OnboardOps: I'll send invites for an onboarding kickoff week of 2025-06-02. Need final SOW + credits table from Priya.

Jamal (AE): Noted. I'll update opportunity and attach signed amendment.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team! Closing this thread. :sparkles:
